primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.

wikipediaRead.title: Er (biblical person)
wikipediaRead.locator: lead and lines 120–123: Judah’s son; line 122 explicitly distinguishes 1 Chronicles 4:21 Er.
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 2:3の初出はユダの子エル。記事冒頭120–122行もユダの子を扱い、4:21の別のエルと区別する。
